event_name: Dodge NHRA Great Lakes Nationals presented by MOPAR

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 63 degrees, relative humidity 66 percent, barometer 30.14 inches,
adjusted altitude 1,331 feet. 

The #12 PSM qualifier is 2 - 6 in the Final round.
The last #12 PSM to win a race was Karen Stoffer, Denver 2012.

Hall is 7 - 4 against Ingwersen in prior events and this is the first time they have faced each other
in a final round.

Ingwersen is a tick too quick on the tree and turns on the red light to give Hall the win.  He wins
his fifth Wally and first this season.  He moves into the second spot in the point chase.
